subject: Computer Science
summary: Covers C from data types, operators and expressions through control statements, functions and recursion, arrays and strings, pointers and dynamic memory, structures, unions and file handling, to the preprocessor and the compilation process. DSSSB regularly asks output-prediction questions (octal/hex constants, % with negatives, ++/--, comma operator, integer division), identifier and keyword rules, and array address calculations, so every rule here is backed by code with its exact output.

sections.heading: C basics: structure, tokens, identifiers
sections.body:
C was developed by **Dennis Ritchie** at **Bell Labs** (early 1970s) to write the UNIX operating system; it is a **middle-level, procedural, compiled** language. Standards: C89/ANSI C, C99, C11, C17.

Every program starts executing at **main()**. A typical program has: preprocessor directives (`#include <stdio.h>`), global declarations, `main()`, and other functions. Statements end with `;` and blocks use `{ }`.

**Tokens**: keywords, identifiers, constants, string literals, operators and punctuators.

**Identifier rules**: letters, digits and underscore only; must **start with a letter or underscore** (never a digit); case-sensitive (`Total` ≠ `total`); cannot be a keyword. Valid: `_count`, `sum2`; invalid: `2sum`, `int`, `my-var`.

**Keywords**: C89 has **32**, all lowercase: auto, break, case, char, const, continue, default, do, double, else, enum, extern, float, for, goto, if, int, long, register, return, short, signed, sizeof, static, struct, switch, typedef, union, unsigned, void, **volatile**, while. C99 added inline, restrict, _Bool, _Complex, _Imaginary. Words like `integer`, `automatic`, `Constant` are not keywords.

Comments: `/* ... */` and (from C99) `// ...`.

sections.heading: Data types, constants and format specifiers
sections.body:
Basic types: **char, int, float, double**, and **void** (no value). Modifiers: **short, long, signed, unsigned**. Sizes depend on the compiler and machine; the standard guarantees only `sizeof(char) == 1` and minimum ranges. The table shows typical sizes on modern 32/64-bit compilers (old 16-bit Turbo C used 2-byte int).

**Constants**: decimal `62`, **octal** with a leading 0 (`017` = 15), **hexadecimal** with 0x (`0x1F` = 31), floating `3.5` (a double) or `3.5f` (a float), character `'A'` (an int with value 65), string `"A"` (two bytes: 'A' and '\0'). Escape sequences: `\n` newline, `\t` tab, `\0` null, `\\` backslash.

`const int N = 10;` creates a read-only variable. **Type conversion**: in mixed expressions the smaller type is promoted (char/short → int → long → float → double) automatically; an explicit **cast** is written `(float)a / b`.

sections.heading: Operators, precedence and expressions
sections.body:
**Arithmetic** `+ - * / %`: integer division **truncates toward zero** (7/2 = 3, −17/5 = −3). `%` works only on integers and the result takes the **sign of the dividend** (−17 % 5 = −2, 17 % −5 = 2). **Relational** `< <= > >= == !=` and **logical** `&& || !` give 1 or 0; `&&` and `||` **short-circuit** (the right side is skipped when the result is already known). **Bitwise**: `& | ^ ~ << >>`. **Assignment**: `= += -= *=` etc. **Increment/decrement**: prefix `++x` changes then uses; postfix `x++` uses then changes. **Conditional** `?:`, **comma** `,` (evaluates left to right, value = last operand), **sizeof**.

**Precedence (high → low)**: `() [] -> .` → unary `! ~ ++ -- - * & sizeof (cast)` → `* / %` → `+ -` → `<< >>` → `< <= > >=` → `== !=` → `&` → `^` → `|` → `&&` → `||` → `?:` → assignment → comma. Unary, conditional and assignment operators associate **right to left**; the others left to right.

Modifying a variable twice in one expression without a sequence point (e.g. `++v * ++v`, `i++ + ++i`) is **undefined behaviour**: the standard fixes no result and compilers do give different answers, so avoid it.

sections.heading: Decision making: if, switch, goto
sections.body:
- **if / if-else / else-if ladder / nested if**: any non-zero value is true, 0 is false. A common bug is `if (x = 5)` (assignment, always true) instead of `if (x == 5)`. A **dangling else** pairs with the nearest unmatched `if`.
- **switch**: the expression must be an **integer or character** (not float or string); `case` labels must be **constant** and unique. Without `break`, execution **falls through** into the following cases. `default` is optional and may appear anywhere.
- **goto label;** jumps unconditionally within a function; it makes code hard to follow and is rarely needed.

The sequence structure executes each statement once in order; selection (if, switch) chooses a path; iteration (loops) repeats.

sections.heading: Loops: for, while, do-while; break and continue
sections.body:
- **while** (entry-controlled): condition tested first; the body may run zero times.
- **for** (entry-controlled): `for (init; condition; update)`; all three parts are optional; `for (;;)` is an **infinite loop**.
- **do-while** (exit-controlled): body runs **at least once**; note the semicolon after `while (cond);`.
- **break** leaves the innermost loop or switch; **continue** skips to the next iteration (in a `for` loop the update still runs).
- A loop that never ends is an **infinite loop**, e.g. `while (1)` or forgetting to update the control variable.

Counting tip: `for (i = a; i < b; i++)` runs b − a times; nested loops where the inner loop starts at the outer index run n + (n − 1) + … + 1 = n(n + 1)/2 times.

sections.heading: Functions, parameter passing and storage classes
sections.body:
A **function** is a named block that performs a task; it is a **subprogram** (other languages call these subroutines or procedures). Parts: **declaration/prototype** (`int add(int, int);`), **definition** (header + body) and **call**. A function returns at most one value with `return`; `void` means no return value. Library functions (printf, sqrt) come from header files; user-defined functions are written by the programmer.

**Parameter passing**: C always passes arguments **by value** (the function gets a copy). To let a function change the caller's variables, pass their **addresses** (pointers); this is called call by reference/address. Arrays are passed as a pointer to the first element.

**Storage classes** decide scope, lifetime and default value:
- **auto**: default for local variables; block scope; garbage initial value; destroyed on exit.
- **register**: request to keep the variable in a CPU register; its address cannot be taken.
- **static**: local static variables are **initialised once** and keep their value between calls; default value 0. A static global or function is visible only in its own file.
- **extern**: declares a global variable defined in another file; default value 0.

sections.heading: Recursion
sections.body:
A **recursive** function calls itself. It needs a **base case** (stops recursion) and a **recursive case** that moves towards the base case; otherwise the program runs out of stack (stack overflow). Each call gets its own **activation record** on the **call stack** (parameters, locals, return address), so recursion uses O(depth) extra memory.

- factorial: n! = n × (n − 1)!, 0! = 1.
- Fibonacci: fib(n) = fib(n − 1) + fib(n − 2), fib(0) = 0, fib(1) = 1. Naive recursion takes exponential time because it recomputes values.
- Tracing tip: statements **before** the recursive call run in calling order (n, n − 1, …); statements **after** it run in reverse order while the calls return.
- **Tail recursion**: the recursive call is the last action, so it can be converted into a loop.

Every recursive solution can be written iteratively (using a loop and, if needed, an explicit stack).

sections.heading: Arrays and address calculation
sections.body:
An **array** is a collection of elements of the **same type** in **contiguous** memory, indexed from **0**. `int a[5];` has a[0] … a[4]; C does **no bounds checking**. Partial initialisation sets the rest to 0: `int a[5] = {10, 20};`. If the size is omitted it is taken from the initialiser.

**Number of elements** with bounds L..U = U − L + 1; for a 2-D array [L1..U1][L2..U2] it is (U1 − L1 + 1) × (U2 − L2 + 1).

C stores 2-D arrays in **row-major** order (row by row). For A[L1..U1][L2..U2] with base address B, element size w and N = U2 − L2 + 1 columns:
- Row-major: Address(A[i][j]) = B + [(i − L1) × N + (j − L2)] × w.
- Column-major (used by FORTRAN), with M = U1 − L1 + 1 rows: Address = B + [(j − L2) × M + (i − L1)] × w.

The array name is a constant pointer to the first element: `a[i]` ≡ `*(a + i)`, and `m[i][j]` ≡ `*(*(m + i) + j)`. A 2-D array whose rows have different lengths is called a **ragged (jagged/irregular)** array; a matrix with mostly zero entries is a **sparse** matrix (mostly non-zero: dense).

sections.heading: Strings and string functions
sections.body:
A **string** is a char array terminated by the **null character '\0'**. `char t[] = "DSSSB";` reserves 6 bytes (5 letters + '\0'). **strlen** counts characters before '\0'; **sizeof** gives the bytes of the whole array.

Functions in `<string.h>`: **strlen(s)**, **strcpy(d, s)** (copy), **strncpy**, **strcat(d, s)** (append), **strcmp(a, b)** (returns 0 if equal, negative if a < b, positive if a > b, by character codes), **strchr**, **strstr**, strrev (non-standard, Turbo C only).

Input/output: `scanf("%s", s)` stops at whitespace; `fgets(s, n, stdin)` reads a whole line safely (`gets` is unsafe and was removed in C11); `puts(s)` prints a string with a newline; `getchar()`/`putchar()` handle one character. Strings cannot be assigned with `=` after declaration or compared with `==`; use strcpy and strcmp.

sections.heading: Pointers
sections.body:
A **pointer** stores the address of another variable. `&x` gives the address of x; `*p` (**dereference / indirection**) gives the value at the address in p. Declaration: `int *p = &x;`.

**Pointer arithmetic** is scaled by the size of the pointed type: if p is an `int *` holding 1000 and int is 4 bytes, p + 1 = 1004. Allowed: pointer ± integer, pointer − pointer (same array, result = number of elements), comparison. Not allowed: adding two pointers, multiplying pointers.

Precedence trap: `*p++` means `*(p++)` (use the value, then move the pointer); `(*p)++` and `++*p` increment the value pointed to.

- **Pointer to pointer**: `int **r = &q;`, then `**r` is the original value.
- **NULL pointer**: points nowhere (`p = NULL`); dereferencing it is an error.
- **void pointer** (`void *`): generic pointer; must be cast before dereferencing; malloc returns one.
- **Dangling pointer**: points to memory that was freed or went out of scope. **Wild pointer**: uninitialised pointer.
- **Function pointer**: `int (*fp)(int, int) = add;`.
- `int *a[5]` is an array of 5 pointers; `int (*a)[5]` is a pointer to an array of 5 ints.

sections.heading: Dynamic memory allocation
sections.body:
Memory requested at run time comes from the **heap**; functions are in `<stdlib.h>`:
- **malloc(size)**: allocates size bytes; contents are **garbage**; returns `void *` or **NULL** on failure.
- **calloc(n, size)**: allocates n × size bytes and **initialises to zero**.
- **realloc(p, newsize)**: resizes a block, keeping old contents (may move it).
- **free(p)**: releases the block. Forgetting to free causes a **memory leak**; using p after free gives a **dangling pointer**, so set it to NULL.

Always check the returned pointer against NULL. Local variables live on the **stack** and are freed automatically; heap memory lives until freed.

sections.heading: Structures, unions, enum and typedef
sections.body:
A **structure** groups variables of **different types** under one name. Members are accessed with the **dot operator** (`s.roll`) or, through a pointer, with the **arrow operator** (`ps->roll`, same as `(*ps).roll`). Structures can be assigned as a whole, passed to and returned from functions, nested, and used in arrays. Each member has its own memory, so **sizeof(struct) ≥ sum of member sizes** (the compiler may add padding for alignment).

A **union** declares members that **share the same memory**; its size is that of the **largest member** (plus any padding). Only the most recently written member holds a meaningful value. Unions save memory when only one member is needed at a time.

- **enum** defines named integer constants starting at 0, each next value = previous + 1: `enum color {RED, GREEN = 5, BLUE};` gives 0, 5, 6.
- **typedef** creates an alias for a type: `typedef struct {int x, y;} Point;`.
- **Bit fields** (`unsigned flag : 1;`) pack members into bits.
- A **self-referential structure** contains a pointer to its own type (`struct node *next;`), used for linked lists and trees.

sections.heading: File handling
sections.body:
Files are accessed through a **FILE \*** pointer from `<stdio.h>`. `fopen(name, mode)` returns NULL on failure; always `fclose(fp)` when done.

**Modes**: `"r"` read (file must exist), `"w"` write (creates or **truncates** to zero length), `"a"` append (writes at end, creates if absent), `"r+"` read and write (file must exist, position at start), `"w+"` read and write (truncates), `"a+"` read and append. Add `b` for binary files (`"rb"`, `"wb"`).

**Functions**: character I/O `fgetc`, `fputc`; string I/O `fgets`, `fputs`; formatted I/O `fprintf`, `fscanf`; block I/O `fread`, `fwrite` (binary records); positioning `fseek(fp, offset, SEEK_SET/SEEK_CUR/SEEK_END)`, `ftell`, `rewind`; `feof` tests end of file; `EOF` (usually −1) is returned at end of file. Standard streams: `stdin`, `stdout`, `stderr`.

Text files store characters (newline translation may occur); binary files store raw bytes.

sections.heading: Preprocessor and the compilation process
sections.body:
The **preprocessor** runs before compilation and handles lines starting with `#`:
- **File inclusion**: `#include <stdio.h>` searches system directories; `#include "my.h"` searches the source file's own directory first, then the system directories.
- **Macros**: `#define PI 3.14` (object-like), `#define SQ(x) ((x) * (x))` (function-like). Macros are **text substitution**: no type checking, no evaluation of arguments first. Always parenthesise each argument and the whole body. `#undef` removes a macro.
- **Conditional compilation**: `#if`, `#ifdef`, `#ifndef`, `#elif`, `#else`, `#endif` (used for header guards and debug code).
- Others: `#pragma`, `#error`; predefined macros `__FILE__`, `__LINE__`, `__DATE__`, `__TIME__`; operators `#` (stringize) and `##` (token pasting).

**Stages of building a C program**:
- **Preprocessing**: prog.c → expanded source (prog.i).
- **Compilation**: → assembly code (prog.s); syntax errors are found here.
- **Assembly**: → object code (prog.o / prog.obj).
- **Linking**: object files + library code → **executable** (a.out / prog.exe). The .exe is created **after linking**; undefined function errors are linker errors.
- **Loading**: the loader places the executable in memory and execution starts at main().

**Command-line arguments**: `int main(int argc, char *argv[])`; argc counts arguments including the program name, argv[0] is the program name.

workedExamples.problem: int A[10][20] is stored with base address 1000 and 4-byte ints. Find the address of A[5][7] in row-major and column-major order.
An array B[2..8][−3..4] has 2-byte elements and base address 2000. Find the number of elements and the address of B[5][1] in row-major and column-major order.

workedExamples.solution:
`*`, `/` and `%` have equal precedence, left to right: b * 2 = 6, 6 % 4 = 2, a / b = 3 (integer division).
c = 10 + 2 − 3 = 9.
Relational operators associate left to right: (5 > 3) = 1, then 1 > 1 = 0, so x = 0.
Output: 9 0

for loop: i = 1 → s = 1; i = 3 → s = 4; i = 9 → s = 13; i = 27 fails the test. Prints 13 27.
while loop: the test uses the old value of i, then decrements. Tests 10, 9, 8, 7 are true (n becomes 4); test 6 > 6 is false, but i is still decremented to 5.
Output: 13 27 4 5

workedExamples.problem:
What does f(7) return?
int f(int n) { if (n <= 1) return 1; return n + f(n - 2); }
Given #define SQUARE(x) x * x, evaluate SQUARE(2 + 3) and 100 / SQUARE(5). Also: char str[] = "PROGRAM"; char *p = str; what do *(p + 3), p[6] and p + 4 (printed with %s) give?
workedExamples.solution:
Macros substitute text: SQUARE(2 + 3) → 2 + 3 * 2 + 3 = 2 + 6 + 3 = 11 (not 25).
100 / SQUARE(5) → 100 / 5 * 5 = 20 * 5 = 100 (not 4).
With #define SQ(x) ((x) * (x)) the answers are 25 and 4.
String: indexes P0 R1 O2 G3 R4 A5 M6. *(p + 3) = 'G'; p[6] = 'M'; p + 4 printed with %s gives "RAM".

pitfalls: A leading zero makes an integer constant octal: 017 is 15, not 17; 0x17 is 23.
% result takes the sign of the dividend: 8 % −3 = 2 and −8 % 3 = −2; integer division truncates toward zero.
5 / 2 is 2 (integer division) even if stored in a float; write 5.0 / 2 or cast to get 2.5.
Expressions like ++v * ++v or i++ + ++i are undefined behaviour; different compilers give different answers.
Missing break in switch causes fall-through into the next cases; switch does not accept float or string expressions.
do-while executes at least once; while and for may execute zero times.
sizeof includes '\0' for a string array; strlen does not: char t[] = "DSSSB" → sizeof 6, strlen 5.
strings must be compared with strcmp, not ==, and copied with strcpy, not =.
*p++ increments the pointer, not the value; use (*p)++ to increment the value.
malloc leaves memory uninitialised; calloc zero-fills it. Always free heap memory and check for NULL.
Macro arguments are substituted as text, so unparenthesised macros give wrong results (SQUARE(2 + 3) = 11).
The executable (.exe) is produced after linking, not after compilation.
quickRevision: C: Dennis Ritchie, Bell Labs, early 1970s; execution starts at main().
Identifiers: letters, digits, underscore; cannot start with a digit; case-sensitive.
C89 has 32 keywords, all lowercase (volatile, register, extern, typedef are keywords).
Precedence: unary > * / % > + − > shifts > relational > equality > & > ^ > | > && > || > ?: > = > comma.
Comma operator returns its last operand: k = (v = 10, v * 3) gives 30.
&& and || short-circuit; any non-zero value is true.
C passes arguments by value; pass addresses to modify the caller's variables.
static local variables keep their value between calls and default to 0.
Recursion needs a base case; each call uses a stack frame.
Arrays are 0-indexed, contiguous, row-major in C; a[i] ≡ *(a + i).
Strings end with '\0'; strcmp returns 0 for equal strings.
Structure size ≥ sum of members; union size = largest member (plus padding).
fopen modes: r, w (truncate), a (append), r+, w+, a+; add b for binary.
Macros are text substitution; parenthesise arguments.
Build stages: preprocess → compile → assemble → link (.exe) → load.
